messages:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY START] v2.4.1 -> US (slice-a) 10% traffic. Canary window = 10m. Rollback triggers: 1) 5% error rate, 2) p95 latency > 350ms. Logs: /releases/v2.4.1/canary

maria: copying notes here — US warm pool checks done, no thermal flags. lucas can you confirm free GPUs and queue depth?

lucas: US pool: 48 GPUs idle across g4/g5, avg queue depth 0.8. warm-pool has 12 reserved. prefix cache hit ~22%. smoke tests ok.

steve: observed single instance of 412 on model shard 3 at +2m, transient. I restarted the shard and it cleared. keeping an eye.

aj: EU hold please — security team has a brief maintenance window in 30m that could affect metadata DB. recommend pin EU until clearance.

karen: ack @aj, pinning EU to v2.3.9 for now. APAC remains blocked until they confirm capacity from their end.

maria: US canary is at 2m. metrics look stable so far. p50=45ms, p95=120ms, errors=0.33% (below threshold).

oncall-bot: Alert (info): canary-window-started v2.4.1 us-slice-a. monitor: latency, error-rate, ingestion-backpressure.

steve: adding a small smoke invoke: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","prompt":"hello"}'` responded 200 in 56ms.

lucas: running a quick load sim: `wrk -t4 -c50 -d60s http://canary-us.elastic/repl` — will post results.

maria: if p95 creeps >250ms we throttle to 5% and extend canary. if >350ms we auto-rollback.

lucas: load sim halfway: qdepth increased to 1.6, p95 ~210ms, GPU util jumped to 72%. still within safe margin.

steve: noticed slight uptick in rerank job latency (background) — not exposed to API, just FYI.

maria: continuing, will keep EU pinned. APAC folks, ping when you have capacity numbers and can accept a staggered slice.

aj: security window cleared early, you have green for EU at +20m. will still want a 15m observe before full traffic.

karen: thanks. I'll schedule EU canary to start at +22m and keep pinned until observed.

deploy-bot: [UPDATE] US canary at 10% -> 30% (after manual lift by maria). Canary metrics: p95=130ms, errors=0.5%. No automatic rollback.

oncall-bot: Warning: background rerank latency > baseline by 28% — not in rollback rules but flagging for QA.

maria: keeping an eye. if error trend hits 1% in next 5m I will pause and roll back.

steve: noted. prepping rollback steps: `deploybot rollback --version v2.3.9 --scopes us` and runbook link: https://infra.internal/runbooks/rollback-v2.

karen: APAC confirmed: 20 GPUs warm, queue depth 0.6 — can start canary at +40m. I'll coordinate handoff.

maria: summary: US progressing, EU pinned then canary at +22m, APAC scheduled +40m. rollback playbook ready. call if thresholds cross. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [CANARY COMPLETE] US slice-a rolled to 60% with no auto-triggers. Remember to file release notes: https://confluence/releases/v2.4.1

maria: filing notes now. closing thread once APAC warmup completes. thanks team. :party_parrot:
